messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - 1715004321 - High 5xx rate detected for model family 'redwood-open-13b' in us-west-2 (inference-pool-12). Paging @kia_oncall and @alex_sre.

kia_oncall: On it. Looking at request rate and infra metrics now. Dashboard shows a sudden 2.8x spike in RPS starting ~02:42Z and KV-cache miss rate is through the roof.

alex_sre: I see memory pressure on 2 GPUs in pool-12. Kernel logs show repeated OOMs triggered by long-context requests (8k+ tokens). Likely workload shift from a customer running long-context summarization.

sara_prod: Customer impact: intermittent stream timeouts and increased tail latency for embeddings calls that route to the same model family. A handful of Dedicated customers reported errors. No increased error billing yet.

mike_eng: Immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle per-model TPM/RPM for redwood-open-13b, 2) enable conservative prefix KV caching, 3) route traffic to a quantized variant. Throttle is fastest.

alex_sre: Agree - do quick quota change to reduce burst. We'll lower TPM and RPM for the redwood-open-13b family and for redwood-open-13b-quantized keep a small headroom as fallback.

kia_oncall: Preparing the change. Applying via admin CLI so it's auditable.

kia_oncall: ```
# set lower per-model quotas for immediate mitigation
redwoodctl quotas set --model redwood-open-13b --tpm 150 --rpm 3000 --reason "emergency: elevated 5xx, reduce burst"
redwoodctl quotas set --model redwood-open-13b-quantized --tpm 200 --rpm 5000 --reason "fallback headroom"
```

ops-bot: Command acknowledged. Executing quota changes across us-west-2 routing table.

ops-bot: Quota change SUCCESS - redwood-open-13b: TPM 900 -> 150, RPM 18000 -> 3000 (applied to routing groups: rw-west-1, rw-west-2).

kia_oncall: Changes applied. Immediately seeing a drop in concurrent inflight on pool-12, 5xx rate is decreasing from 7.2% -> 1.6% over the past 2 minutes.

sara_prod: Early customer chatter: some clients hit rate limits and received 429s; support is triaging for dedicated customers. Please capture affected org ids and escalate if SLA breach.

jules_support: Notifying the handful of impacted Dedicated customers and opening support tickets. Posting short message to status.redwood.ai about rate limiting applied to redwood-open-13b in us-west-2.

mike_eng: Next step: increase caching TTL for long prefix keys and enable temporary routing preference to quantized variant for low-priority routes. But keep the throttle in place until we've stabilized (couple hours).

alex_sre: I'll schedule a canary routing rule to shift 10% of traffic to redwood-open-13b-quantized to validate output quality. Command: 
```
redwoodctl routing update --from-model redwood-open-13b --to-model redwood-open-13b-quantized --percent 10 --region us-west-2 --reason "canary fallback after quota throttle"
```

ops-bot: Routing change applied: 10% -> redwood-open-13b-quantized in us-west-2.

kia_oncall: Monitoring logs for regressions. Also added a temporary alert for sustained 429 > 5% for a 10m window.

sara_prod: Action items for handoff: 1) keep throttle in place, 2) monitor 5xx & 429 and latency tail, 3) identify top offending org ids and coordinate with Account team for temporary increases if needed.

kia_oncall: Handing off to @alex_sre for the night shift. Summary: quota throttle applied (redwood-open-13b TPM=150 RPM=3000), 10% canary to quantized variant. Stabilized error rate from 7.2% -> 0.9% and tail latency improving. Rollback path: redwoodctl quotas set --model redwood-open-13b --tpm <old_tpm> --rpm <old_rpm>.

alex_sre: Taking over. I'll keep the throttle and routing in place for 3 hours, then we can incrementally raise RPM/TMP if metrics stay healthy. Will start a short eval run to check output quality differences in the quantized path.

jules_support: Support tickets created for affected Dedicated customers and flagged for priority follow-up. Also added a note to the incident channel for postmortem.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - 1715004900 - 5xx rate returned to baseline, no further OOMs observed in pool-12.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED - 1715005123 - Mitigation successful. Postmortem: assigned to @alex_sre and @mike_eng. Please include timeline, root cause analysis (long-context workload bump + insufficient KV eviction heuristics), and recommendations (per-model automatic throttling thresholds, dynamic cache tuning, improve alerting on KV cache evictions). :white_check_mark:

alex_sre: I'll draft the postmortem and include recommended follow-ups: automatic per-model ramp-down when KV cache miss rate > 20% and an automated canary to quantized variant. Handoff notes stored in #oncall-log.

sara_prod: Thanks team. Quick retrospective note: need clearer customer communication template for temporary throttles to reduce support noise.

jules_support: Affected customers notified, monitoring for follow-ups. Closing out. :thumbsup:
